title: The dashboard has one mode: no Fun toggle
description: A real browser on the built dashboard: no Fun control exists on the Work, Master, Workers or Settings pages; a stored Fun preference from before the change (graphyard.fun = off) has no effect, so the build line, agent names and the trust strip still show and the page carries no data-fun attribute; the left menu and the Master page read Master and Workers; and no source file under web/ or src/ references the Fun mode setting.

steps.name: one mode, no Fun toggle, on the dashboard
